mapper.select: SELECT id FROM technician_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active = true AND approval_status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT ta.id, r.move_request_id, ta.status, r.reservation_no, r.scheduled_start_at, r.scheduled_end_at, customer.name AS customer_name, customer.phone AS customer_phone, mr.origin_address, mr.destination_address, string_agg(DISTINCT appliance_type.name, ', ' ORDER BY appliance_type.name) AS appliance_types, mr.customer_memo, quote.quote_no, quote.total_amount FROM technician_assignment ta JOIN reservation r ON r.id = ta.reservation_id JOIN quote ON quote.id = r.quote_id JOIN move_request mr ON mr.id = r.move_request_id JOIN app_user customer ON customer.id = mr.customer_id JOIN move_item mi ON mi.move_request_id = mr.id JOIN appliance_type ON appliance_type.id = mi.appliance_type_id WHERE ta.technician_id = #{profileId} AND (#{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::varchar IS NULL OR ta.status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) GROUP BY ta.id, r.move_request_id, ta.status, r.reservation_no, r.scheduled_start_at, r.scheduled_end_at, customer.name, customer.phone, mr.origin_address, mr.destination_address, mr.customer_memo, quote.quote_no, quote.total_amount ORDER BY r.scheduled_start_at, ta.assigned_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM technician_assignment WHERE technician_id = #{profileId} AND (#{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::varchar IS NULL OR status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
SELECT status FROM technician_assignment WHERE id = #{assignmentId} AND technician_id = #{profileId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE technician_assignment SET status = #{status}, responded_at = COALESCE(responded_at, now()), completed_at = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN now() ELSE completed_at END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{assignmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_event (id, assignment_id, event_type, note, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{assignmentId}, #{eventType}, #{note}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT ta.id, r.move_request_id, ta.status, r.reservation_no, r.scheduled_start_at, r.scheduled_end_at, customer.name AS customer_name, customer.phone AS customer_phone, mr.origin_address, mr.destination_address, string_agg(DISTINCT appliance_type.name, ', ' ORDER BY appliance_type.name) AS appliance_types, mr.customer_memo, quote.quote_no, quote.total_amount FROM technician_assignment ta JOIN reservation r ON r.id = ta.reservation_id JOIN quote ON quote.id = r.quote_id JOIN move_request mr ON mr.id = r.move_request_id JOIN app_user customer ON customer.id = mr.customer_id JOIN move_item mi ON mi.move_request_id = mr.id JOIN appliance_type ON appliance_type.id = mi.appliance_type_id WHERE ta.id = #{assignmentId} AND ta.technician_id = #{profileId} GROUP BY ta.id, r.move_request_id, ta.status, r.reservation_no, r.scheduled_start_at, r.scheduled_end_at, customer.name, customer.phone, mr.origin_address, mr.destination_address, mr.customer_memo, quote.quote_no, quote.total_amount
